---
name: Feature or extension proposal
about: Propose a new capability, statistic, or scientific extension
title: "[extension] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Motivation**
What problem does this solve, or what science does it enable? If it relates to
one of the **Future extensions** in the README, link it.

**Proposed approach**
How might it work? Which modules / config sections / stages would it touch?

**Starting points**
Existing functions or files that could be reused
(e.g. `foregrounds_diffusion/…`, `pipeline/…`).

**Obstacles / open questions**
Data availability, compute cost, evaluation, anything unresolved.
